findings.message: Heading in Title Case: use sentence case unless the brand says otherwise.
findings.instead: Use sentence case for headings unless the brand's style guide says otherwise.

findings.message: "In today's fast-paced world" adds words without meaning.
findings.instead: Say the concrete thing. For long prose, also run a full writing linter.

findings.message: "it's worth noting" adds words without meaning.
findings.instead: Say the concrete thing. For long prose, also run a full writing linter.

findings.message: "genuinely passionate": show it with a fact rather than announcing it.
findings.instead: Show the quality with a fact or an admission. Give the reason instead of saying a choice was a choice.

findings.message: "are able to": use the short form.
findings.instead: Use the short form: can, because, now, to, many.

findings.message: "due to the fact that": use the short form.
findings.instead: Use the short form: can, because, now, to, many.

findings.message: 2 sentences open on stock connectors (Moreover, Furthermore).
findings.instead: Let the logic join the sentences. Most of these words can go.

findings.message: 3 exclamation marks in body copy.
findings.instead: Let the words carry the energy. One exclamation mark in a long piece at most.

findings.message: Bullet that opens with a bolded label: write it as a plain sentence.
findings.instead: Write each heading as what the section shows. Write bullets as plain sentences.

findings.message: 1 em dash: use commas, colons, parentheses or a new sentence.
findings.instead: Rewrite the sentence with a comma, a colon, brackets or a full stop.

findings.message: "serves as a": use is, has or does, or name the thing.
findings.instead: Use is, has or does. Name the street or the thing.

findings.message: "in the heart of": use is, has or does, or name the thing.
findings.instead: Use is, has or does. Name the street or the thing.

findings.message: ", fostering ..." claims a meaning the sentence never shows: state the result or stop at the fact.
findings.instead: Say the concrete result, or stop at the fact.

findings.message: Heading that could sit over any section: say what this one shows.
findings.instead: Write each heading as what the section shows. Write bullets as plain sentences.
